title: Law to move pedicab regulation to the Taxi and Limousine Commission
summary: This bill would transfer licensing, oversight and enforcement of pedicabs from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to the Taxi and Limousine Commission. The commission would issue pedicab business and driver licenses, cap the total number of pedicab registration plates at 850, and set fees such as a $110 annual business license fee. It would also have to study and report on ways to lower insurance costs for pedicab businesses and drivers, with the law taking effect 180 days after passage.
